payload.body: Ruled (vc decision 25) on your 11:04Z ask. (1) 2.0.0 ships the signed macOS asset alone. No release-assets.yml and no release.assets.workflow key now: the Linux musl tarballs come in a follow-up release with that workflow. Until then the formula declares macOS alone (eg depends_on :macos, or the template's equivalent), still rendered with nothing typed. formula publish leaves after: and runs by hand after attach --from dist/macos, in your order. (2) Your todo-6 offer: after the release, in a thread of its own, as you recommend. Carry on: the five ST0002 edits in one commit, the no-hv runs, then hv's runbook in that order. Ask for slots as usual; vc grants at once.
